meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过查阅代码库的「知识图谱」和源码，深入解析你指定的文件、函数或模块：说明它在架构中的角色、内部结构、外部依赖和数据流向，用通俗语言讲清楚。
howto.when: 当你想深入理解代码库中某个具体文件、函数或模块的工作原理时触发。直接给出文件路径（如 src/auth/login.ts）或「路径:函数名」的写法即可。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件是干什么的
say.note: 会查知识图谱并读取源码，说出它的职责和结构

say.text: 帮我梳理 payment/service.ts 被哪些地方调用了
say.note: 会顺着依赖关系找出调用它的模块

howto.what_en: Claude reads the codebase's knowledge graph and source files to deeply explain a target file, function, or module: its architectural role, internal structure, dependencies, and data flow, in plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for an in-depth explanation of a specific file, function, or module, typically by providing a file path (e.g., src/auth/login.ts) or function notation.

say_en.note: Finds the file node and explains its role and structure.

say_en.text: How does the formatDate function in utils/formatDate.ts work?
say_en.note: Explains the function's inputs, processing, and output.

say_en.text: Which parts of the codebase call payment/service.ts?
say_en.note: Follows incoming edges to list its callers and connections.
